To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the pumpkin seeds have a protective effect against diet-induced atherosclerotic changes in rats.
pumpkin seeds supplementation can decrease serum concentrations of total and LDL-cholesterol in atherogenic diet fed rats.
pumpkin seeds supplementation to atherogenic rats significantly reduced serum concentrations of LDL-C and total cholesterol and significantly increased HDL-C concentrations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of pumpkin seeds supplementation in atherogenic diet induced atherosclerosis.
the beneficial effect of Cucurbita seeds on serum lipid concentrations and the possible role of arginine in this effect.
the potential of pumpkin seeds as a functional food in the treatment of atherosclerosis.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
pumpkin seeds supplementation is effective in decreasing the serum concentrations of total and LDL-cholesterol in atherogenic rat model.
pumpkin seed supplementation is an effective and safe treatment to reduce atherosclerosis in rats.
the pumpkin seeds supplementation has an anti-atherosclerotic effect.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
pumpkin seeds supplementation can be used as a natural and effective way to prevent atherogenesis.
pumpkin seeds supplementation could be considered as an alternative to arginine in prevention of atherogenesis.
the effect of pumpkin seed supplementation on the serum concentrations of TC, HDL-C and LDL-C is not attributed only to the high argininc concentrations in pumpkin seeds.

the use of pumpkin seeds as a food source is an important strategy for the prevention and treatment of hypercholesterolemia and hypercholesterolemic cardiovascular diseases.

pumpkin seeds are a rich natural source of bioactive compounds with a protective effect against cardiovascular disease.
